messages:
maria_marketing: Quick heads-up — planning to announce the Optimize v1.3 rollout next Tuesday (03/09) at 10:00 PT. Need confirmation on changelog finalization, docs URLs, and canary timing so marketing can lock the post and webinar invite.

noah_eng: 👍 working on the changelog now. Will drop the final bullet list by EOD tomorrow. Are we doing staged rollout or single wave?

maria_marketing: Prefer staged: canary to 5% for the first 2 hours, then 25% next 4 hours, full at +1 day. That helps webinar demos not hit surprises. If eng prefers different, say now.

noah_eng: Staged sounds good. We'll need a fallback model variant in the routing policy in case of perf regressions. I'll add fallback config.

priya_docs: I can prep the docs pages. Can you share the exact changelog bullets? Also need the final config snippet for the rollout to paste into the release notes.

noah_eng: Draft changelog (WIP):
- Improve batching heuristics to reduce tail latency for short prompts
- Added prefix KV cache invalidation fix for multi-tenant pools
- New quantization profile (q4_legacy) that reduces memory 20% with minimal quality impact
- Canary routing and automatic fallback to smaller-context model variant

maria_marketing: Love it. Priya — can you alias the docs links like /docs/release/optimize-1-3 and /docs/guides/quantization? We need canonical links for the announcement and webinar follow-up.

priya_docs: Yep. I'll create the release page and the how-to. ETA: tomorrow noon PT. Will include example rollout YAML under a code block and a short troubleshooting section.

sam_product: Also add a short paragraph on why q4_legacy exists and recommended workloads (low-latency chat, high concurrency inference). We'll need a callout about small quality delta and suggested evals.

lena_design: I'll prepare the hero image and a set of social tiles. Any messaging constraints? We should avoid promising specific latency numbers.

maria_marketing: Correct — avoid hard latency claims. Focus on percent memory reduction and better tail behavior. Also include benchmark narratives: "real-world chat workloads saw 15-25% fewer tail spikes" (use internal benchmark deck).

noah_eng: Deployment plan: canary rollout at 10:00 PT, health checks on 95th latency and error rate for first 15m windows. If 95th increases >15% or error rate >0.5% we'll auto-roll back. release-bot will post status updates to #release-war-room.

release-bot: FYI — I've scheduled the canary for 1769519999 (10:00 PT) and will ping the channel at each stage.

priya_docs: One question on the code snippet: do we want to show the autoscale config? It has customer-specific values.

sam_product: No, just show an anonymized example so customers can copy the pattern but not internal capacity values.

maria_marketing: Timeline recap: tomorrow EOD — final changelog from eng. Tomorrow noon — docs pages live. Monday morning — design assets ready. Tuesday 10:00 PT — announce + canary. Wed — webinar invite goes out to opt-in users with demo link.

noah_eng: Confirmed. I'll post the final changelog timestamped when complete.

priya_docs: Will post doc URLs here when ready.

lena_design: I'll upload images to the marketing drive and drop links here by Monday AM.

maria_marketing: Thanks all. If anyone anticipates delays, flag here ASAP. :thumbsup:

noah_eng: small note — adding a short snippet to the changelog about rollback conditions so SRE knows exact thresholds.

maria_marketing: Perfect — we'll include that in the announcement appendix.

release-bot: Reminder scheduled: 1769520000 — pre-launch checklist ping to this channel.
